# CryptRover Copilot Instructions

- **Project**: Terminal roguelike built with C99 + ncurses (optional SDL_mixer audio). Core loop and globals live in [src/main.c](src/main.c); map/entity/item definitions in [src/map.h](src/map.h), [src/entities.h](src/entities.h), [src/items.h](src/items.h).
- **Build/Run**: `./configure && make` builds binary `cr`; `./configure --with-pdc` forces PDCurses on *nix, `--without-sdl` disables sound, `--debug` enables `-O0 -g -Wall -Wextra -pedantic`. Cross Windows build via `CROSS=1 make`. Assets expected in media/, scores written to `scores.dat` in repo root.
- **State layout**: Map grids `tile_m`, `tile_color_m`, `view_m` are globals in [src/main.c](src/main.c) defined by constants in [src/map.h](src/map.h). Entities `ent_l` with occupancy map `ent_m` and items `item_l` with `item_m` are likewise global; player is `ent_l[0]`.
- **Map generation**: [src/map.c](src/map.c) carves rooms/corridors from center outward via `dig_level()` using Bresenham `los()` from [src/utils.c](src/utils.c). Parameters (`ROOM_RADIUS`, `PATHS`, `LAST_LEVEL`) in [src/map.h](src/map.h); exactly one up-stair `<` placed on a random floor tile.
- **Turn flow** (see [src/main.c](src/main.c)): read normalized input → `player_action()` moves/acts or toggles light/help/quit/stair → `use_item()` auto-consumes item on the tile → each arachnid may move via `move_enemy()` when its speed gate passes → FOV tiles decay, then recomputed with `fov()` (battery-scaled radius) → battery drains if light on, air drains every turn → redraw + HUD update → lose/win checks.
- **Input**: Use `readchar()` from [src/io.c](src/io.c) which delegates to terminal-normalizing `md_readchar()` in [src/mdport.c](src/mdport.c) (maps vi/WASD/numpad/shift/ctrl variants). Preserve this funnel when adding controls so mappings stay consistent.
- **Rendering/UI**: Curses windows/panels set up in [src/io.c](src/io.c); map drawn from `tile_m` plus fog `view_m`, corpses tinted via `tile_color_m`, items hidden unless seen, entities only when in sight. HUD bars and item legend in `print_info()`; event log via `add_message()` in a scrolling window.
- **Entities/AI**: Enemy arachnids spawn asleep in `init_ents()` ([src/entities.c](src/entities.c)), wake on LOS within `FOV_RADIUS`, then chase by sorting adjacent tiles by distance (`compare_tiles()`); otherwise wander. Combat resolved in `move_to()`; player/enemy-only attacks; corpses and blood tint tiles on death.
- **Items/resources**: `init_items()` ([src/items.c](src/items.c)) scatters med packs `+`, air cans `*`, batteries `!`, coins `$` on empty floor not on stairs/entities; types assigned by index order. `use_item()` auto-applies when standing on it; clamps to caps (`PLAYER_HP`, `PLAYER_AIR`, `PLAYER_BATTERY`) from [src/entities.h](src/entities.h) and [src/items.h](src/items.h).
- **Vision**: `fov()` in [src/entities.c](src/entities.c) marks `view_m` within battery-scaled radius if `los()` permits; unseen→seen fog handled in main loop. When moving entities manually, keep `ent_m` in sync to avoid desync in drawing and collision.
- **Audio**: Guarded by `__SDL__`; sounds for bites/punches/grunts/alerts/pickups, plus looping music in [src/main.c](src/main.c). Safe to stub if SDL is unavailable; build flag `SDL=1` enables.
- **Persistence**: `save_score()` in [src/main.c](src/main.c) appends text lines to `scores.dat`; `show_highscore()` in [src/io.c](src/io.c) reads/sorts/displays them. Avoid changing format unless updating both save/read paths.
- **Conventions**: Keep ASCII glyph-based visuals; colors via `COLOR_PAIR` macros in [src/io.h](src/io.h). Globals are intentionally shared; new modules should declare `extern` in headers and define once. Prefer `add_message()` for player feedback and respect fog rules when revealing entities/items.
- **Debugging tips**: Use `DBG=1 make` or `./configure --debug` for symbols and warnings; disable strip. If movement feels off on some terminals, adjust mappings in [src/mdport.c](src/mdport.c) rather than scattering key handling elsewhere.
- **Web port notes**: [js-plan.md](js-plan.md) sketches a TypeScript/browser rewrite mirroring C module boundaries and data shapes; follow that mapping if extending web work.
